reply: a structural miss, not a near-exact match: `-26.49*sqrt(T) - 5.55*log(1 - 0.0158*eps)*T^2 + 13.20*exp(-1.23*eps - 0.26/T) + 26.24*eps^0.027*T^0.564*exp(-0.103/T)`. Those fitted constants look degenerate (the log term is nearly linear in eps), so I wouldn't trust that expression as the physical law.
